incident-bot: Paging: severity=sev2 service=runtime region=us-west-2 — high error rate detected on model-serving fleet. Pager duty: Dave (on-call)
Dave (on-call): on it. joining bridge in 1m. can someone drop latest alert graph? :eyes:
Alice M: I pulled grafana panel, error spike at 15:03 UTC, 5xx rate ~18% for 10m. linking: https://grafana.redwood/example/panel -> paste in bridge
Ben R: I see increased KV cache miss and OOM reclaim traces in system logs. hypothesis: cache eviction cascade on nodes serving long-context requests.
Carol L: grabbing logs from affected pods now. command: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime,zone=us-west-2 --since=15m`
Carol L: putting a brief log snippet here:
```
2026-03-15T15:02:57Z runtime[pid=2345]: kv_cache: eviction threshold exceeded
2026-03-15T15:03:01Z runtime[pid=2345]: oom_killer invoked, process slain: worker-12
2026-03-15T15:03:04Z runtime[pid=2345]: upstream model fallback triggered to smaller-variant
```
Dave (on-call): thanks. can we confirm customer impact? Leah - Support, do we have active customer reports?
Leah - Support: triage queue shows 7 incoming tickets referencing timeouts / 500s since 15:05 UTC. top affected tenants: acme-inc, beta-saas. estimated users impacted: ~800 requests/min at peak.
Morgan - Eng PM: we should draft status page update. Leah can you own
